svg.title: Coding agent end-to-end throughput by model and service tier
svg.desc: Three-hour KST buckets of output tokens divided by total request duration, separated by provider, model and service tier. Solid lines are default, dashed lines priority, dotted lines other tiers. Gaps mean no valid measurement. End labels show each series last valid observation.
svg.text: 대기 포함 TPS · 출력 토큰 / 전체 요청시간
정상 응답 수 · 구간별 표본, 건
빈 구간은 응답 없음 · 곡선은 표시용 보간 · 마지막 03:00–03:30 부분 집계
